name: China Tourism Group Duty Free Corporation Limited
summary: China Tourism Group Duty Free Corporation Limited, established in 2008 and headquartered in Sanya, operates duty-free travel retail in China and is a subsidiary of China Tourism Group Co., Ltd. It sells tobacco, alcohol, fragrances, beauty products, fashion accessories, clothing and electronics at wholesale and retail, and also invests in and develops commercial property. It was named China International Travel Service Corporation Limited until June 2020.
